use_case_summary: Goal: low-latency operator assistant + reranking for telemetry logs. Primary workloads: short-chat prompts for actionable summaries (p99 SLA 120ms), reranking for anomaly detection pipelines, and embeddings for sparse retrieval. Cost sensitivity moderate; prefer predictable monthly committed capacity for peak periods.
poc_details: Scope: 2-week dedicated POC (staging) using quantized Llama-variant. Success metrics: p99 latency <=120ms, throughput >=150 req/s, embedding cosine parity with baseline, and operational readiness for VPC. What ran: model deployed to a sandbox instance; synthetic queries executed but integration stalled because customer SDK integration and VPC peering never completed. Security team requested KMS proof and data residency statement; those docs partially delivered. Outcome: POC incomplete, missed two milestones.
